card.name: Interferon names before alpha or beta
card.fires_on: The last piece of the word interferon, or its abbreviation IFN, right before a Greek-letter type such as alpha or beta. Seen in cytokine lists and in drug interaction or contraindication text.

modes.label: IFN in cytokine list
modes.description: The abbreviation IFN closes a list of cytokines such as IL-6 and TNFα in a sentence about chronic inflammation.
modes.example: IL-1, IL-6, TNFα, IF<<N>>) during chronic inflammation.

modes.label: Interferon spelled out
modes.description: The end of the word interferon sits just before alfa or beta in a drug name or class.

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word is alpha or beta, the interferon type.
card.plain: It spots the word interferon, or IFN, where a type like alpha or beta comes next.
